about: The open house is part of the museum's Christmas at the Mansion season, which also includes a ticketed tea in the historic Turner Mansion on Dec 8 and the ReinBeer beer festival on Dec 10. Those two are not family events, so this free Sunday afternoon is the one to pick for kids.
The museum is also home to a Durham Children's Museum and a planetarium, and it is open Sundays from 2 to 5 PM, the same window as the open house.

The museum is at 1705 W Missouri Ave in Midland. The museum is closed on Mondays and open Tuesday through Saturday from 10 AM to 5 PM, so families who want more time with the exhibits can come back during the week.
faq: Do I need to bring a gingerbread house?
Yes, bring your own for the workshop. A cardboard gingerbread house is sold in the museum gift shop while supplies last.
No. The museum says the open house is free and no reservations are required.
